items.title: Judge denies motion asking for Lindsay Clancy to be found not guilty due to lack of evidence

items.title: What we know about Tennessee's botched execution of Christa Pike
items.feed_summary: Tennessee officials failed to carry out the lethal injection of death row inmate Christa Pike on Wednesday. Her attorneys say she is alive and in critical condition after being given two separate doses of pentobarbital meant to kill her. Pike was sentenced to death for the gruesome murder of her classmate in 1995. Amna Nawaz discussed more with Deborah Denno, a professor at Fordham School of Law.

items.title: Investigators search for motive after alleged attack by FlyDubai co-pilot
items.feed_summary: Investigators across the Middle East are hunting for answers after a co-pilot stabbed his captain and allegedly attempted to crash a FlyDubai aircraft bound for Israel. President Trump claimed the attack could be linked to Iran, but did not provide evidence. Geoff Bennett discussed what we do and don't know with Juliette Kayyem, a former assistant secretary at the Department of Homeland Security.

items.title: Student protests grip France as Prime Minister Lecornu calls crisis meeting

items.title: News Wrap: Supreme Court to review mandatory detention policy for migrants

items.title: New details intensify scrutiny of Cornell's handling of gang rape allegations

New reporting out today finds Cornell police left out key information in a statement given to local law enforcement. That includes Jane Doe's statement, "I can say with 100 percent confidence I was raped." Amna Nawaz discussed more with Sharon Otterman of The New York Times.

items.title: A look at Hegseth's attempts to reshape the Pentagon
items.feed_summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth says he is fundamentally reshaping the culture of the U.S. military. He's removing senior officers, dismantling diversity initiatives and putting a new emphasis on religious faith and what he calls a "warrior ethos." Beyond the cultural changes, Hegseth is accelerating autonomous weapons and other emerging technologies. Geoff Bennett discussed more with Peter Feaver.
